order_note: Apply after SQL 82 (reviewed order). Not enforced: SQL 83 does not depend on SQL 82 and the SQL 81 template has no predecessor check, so predecessors is [].

production_inspect.note: Pending: no read-only production inspect has been run for SQL 83. The production pre-state is not code-derived (the functions may be absent, SQL 68's thin ledger view, or another version), so expected_live_definition_sha256 is null and evaluate and apply refuse. Run node scripts/deployment-guard/sql83-homeowner-signing-production-apply.mjs --inspect on the runner and record its date, SSM command id, source commit, live_definition_sha256, function_states, functions (arguments, owner, proacl), precondition_failures and apply_preconditions_met here, and copy live_definition_sha256 into expected_live_definition_sha256, in the reviewed change that sets execute true. If precondition_failures is not [] (another signature, a non-jsonb result, other parameter names, another owner, an ACL entry the file does not revoke, an owner that cannot bypass RLS), stop: that needs its own reviewed change. SQL 83 sets row_security=off, so the owner must be superuser or BYPASSRLS, or own every RLS table its bodies read without FORCE RLS (row_security_off_supported).

intended_post_state.note: After the unchanged SQL 83 file run as checksops_admin: each function exists once (no other signature of that name in any schema), owned by checksops_admin, SECURITY DEFINER with search_path=public and row_security=off, the reviewed body (pg_get_functiondef compared with the text reconstructed from the pinned file), EXECUTE for the owner and checksops only (PUBLIC and authenticated revoked). intended_replacement_sha256 equals the staging pin's (the owner's own ACL entry is not part of the fingerprint). function_owner is the expected production login (as for SQL 72 to 81); the first inspect must confirm it.

staging_acceptance.basis: Pending: record the guarded staging SQL executor read-live and apply runs of sql83-homeowner-signing-capabilities here in the reviewed change that sets execute true. Until then evaluate and apply refuse with PRODUCTION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED (and SQL_COLLISION while expected_live_definition_sha256 is null).
staging_acceptance.production_differs: Unknown until the first inspect of each environment: staging is expected to carry Cursor's SQL 73 ledger view and possibly Cursor SQL 74 functions of the same names, so the staging and production pre-state hashes are recorded separately. The post-state fingerprint is the same in both; the same file bytes (source_sha256) run in both.
